scope: All local records inventoried; core-series incoming evolution methods plus the GO-only Meltan exception. Not a complete game-by-game evolution availability matrix or GO candy/buddy/task audit.

bulbapedia.timestamp: original fetch timestamps not stored by existing cache; not refreshed in this audit

serebii.timestamp: original fetch timestamps not stored by existing cache; not refreshed in this audit

findings.title: Trade trigger not recorded
findings.detail: Each record has at least one trade route, but evoFromTrading is absent. Held-item trades currently look indistinguishable from using an item. Scope routes to games: do not turn a trade route into a universal requirement where Legends: Arceus offers item use or Milotic also permits Beauty.

findings.title: Friendship requirement not recorded
findings.detail: evoFromFriendship is absent. This includes Sylveon in newer games; its older affection route must remain separate. A boolean is sufficient for display, but any numerical threshold needs game scope.

findings.title: Explicit evolution gender condition not recorded
findings.detail: evoFromGender is absent for male/female gated evolutions and the distinct gender-based result forms in these upstream rules. Do not derive permissive evolution conditions from species gender ratios.

findings.title: Wrong exact predecessor form
findings.detail: These records point to the default predecessor rather than the matching sea, season, or cloak. The required predecessor forms already exist locally.

findings.title: Meltan to Melmetal evolution missing
findings.detail: Add Meltan as the predecessor and a GO-only method consuming 400 Meltan Candy. Meltan cannot evolve in the core series. The PokeAPI version-group introduction value is not an allowed-game list.

findings.title: Union Circle requirement missing
findings.detail: Keep level 38; also require a Union Circle session with another player. Hero Form is a subsequent battle transformation, not a separate evolution from Finizen.

findings.title: Shedinja castoff conditions missing
findings.detail: The existing Nincada/level-20 link omits the Ninjask evolution event, a spare party slot, and a regular Poke Ball in the bag in Generation IV onward. Generation III does not require the spare Poke Ball. Model as an additional result, not an exclusive choice between Ninjask and Shedinja.

findings.title: Hidden-value branch conditions missing
findings.detail: Wurmple branches depend on personality value/encryption constant; Maushold and Dudunsparce forms depend on encryption constant (99:1 distribution). These are fixed per individual, not fresh random rolls each evolution attempt. A translated note key is adequate; no expression evaluator is needed.

findings.title: Nature-based result form missing
findings.detail: Level 30 is recorded, but the 13 Amped and 12 Low Key original natures are absent. Mints do not change the evolution outcome.

findings.title: Alcremie result-form recipe missing
findings.detail: All 63 forms share the same generic spinning note. Each needs its exact held Sweet plus the cream recipe: direction, duration, and time. Nine cream recipes times seven Sweets; game-specific evening timing requires scope.

findings.title: Held and used items are conflated
findings.detail: evoFromItem has no role. Distinguish held items, directly used items, and quantities in the bag. Several of these held items are directly used in Legends: Arceus, so a single global held-item flag is also insufficient.

findings.title: Known item only stored in prose
findings.detail: Black Augurite and Peat Block are only English prose and are absent from the local item catalog. Add the catalog entries before structured references. Preserve full moon for Ursaluna and restrict supported methods to their games.

findings.title: Location versus stone alternatives missing
findings.detail: Stored data selects only one historical route. Retain magnetic-field/Moss Rock/Ice Rock/Mount Lanakila alternatives and applicable stone routes by concrete game. Probopass supports Thunder Stone in Legends: Arceus, earlier than the introduction encoded in the downloaded PokeAPI stone row. Do not use a simple generation >= 8 rule for BDSP.

findings.title: Legends Arceus item-use alternatives missing
findings.detail: PLA adds Linking Cord alternatives for the four ordinary trade species; trade-held items and held level-up items become direct-use items there. Time-of-day conditions remain where applicable. PokeAPI does not enumerate all these alternatives. Preserve the manual evolve action in PLA presentation.

findings.title: Beauty alternative missing
findings.detail: Add level-up with Beauty >=170 alongside the Prism Scale trade route, with game support. Beauty can remain an eligible hidden value on a transferred Feebas even where the destination has no way to raise it.

findings.title: Game-dependent level collapsed
findings.detail: Current level 14 is valid in other core games; Legends: Arceus requires level 17. One evoFromLevel cannot represent both.

findings.title: Game-dependent special method collapsed
findings.detail: Overqwil differs across PLA, SV and ZA; Urshifu needs scroll interaction in the towers in SwSh versus consumable scroll items in SV; Sylveon changes affection to friendship; Basculegion needs a final level-up in SV but not PLA; Runerigus has game-specific arches. See narrative for source disagreements and precise requirements.

findings.title: Regional result selection not recorded
findings.detail: The same source record can produce different regional destinations depending on the game/location of evolution. Encode both positive and negative scopes, including Ultra Space exceptions in USUM. The specimen origin region alone does not determine the result.

findings.title: Paired-game branch not recorded
findings.detail: Both say Cosmoem at level 53. Solgaleo requires Sun/Ultra Sun/Sword/Scarlet; Lunala requires Moon/Ultra Moon/Shield/Violet. PokeAPI version-group sun-moon does not distinguish the two games.

findings.title: Rockruff ability/form and game constraints not structured
findings.detail: Dusk text correctly mentions Own Tempo, but evoFromAbility is unused and no Own Tempo Rockruff record exists locally. Retain explicit special-form/ability eligibility (and the ordinary forms exclusion), day/night/dusk, Gen VII version restrictions, and game-specific dusk windows. Do not imply an Ability Capsule/Patch converts ordinary Rockruff to Own Tempo.

findings.title: Final action missing from walking note
findings.detail: The notes record 1000 Lets Go steps but omit the subsequent level-up while outside the Poke Ball. Keep the counter and final action as distinct requirements; auto-battle EXP itself cannot trigger ordinary evolution.

findings.title: Battle level-up restriction missing
findings.detail: Level 25 alone is incomplete: Tandemaus needs experience from battle. Candy level-ups are not equivalent. Keep this separate from the hidden-value result-form condition.

findings.title: Defeated-opponent item condition underspecified
findings.detail: The current note mentions pack-leading Bisharp but omits the actual Leader Crest condition on defeated opponents. Require defeating three Bisharp holding the item, then level up. The evolving Bisharp does not need to hold it.

findings.title: Multiple eligible predecessor records
findings.detail: Male Burmy of any cloak can become Mothim. Both Chest and transferred Roaming Form Gimmighoul can evolve into Gholdengo. Bulbapedia shares the method and result cells across both source rows using rowspan=2; flattened text hides that relationship. The flat predecessor field cannot express these alternatives.

findings.title: Cosmetic female predecessor convention ambiguous
findings.detail: These female result records point to the unsuffixed predecessor even though a female predecessor record exists. Decide whether unsuffixed IDs mean an exact form or a species aggregate, then preserve gender consistently. These are not counted as the six confirmed non-cosmetic wrong links.

findings.title: Vivillon pattern eligibility absent
findings.detail: Level 12 is correct, but 19 destination patterns share an unrestricted Spewpa predecessor. Pattern metadata depends on originating game/geography, transferred individual data, and GO postcards in SV. Fancy is the default in SV; Poke Ball pattern must remain excluded from ordinary evolution.

findings.title: English-only condition strings
findings.detail: Existing notes are useful evidence, not all errors. Replace recurring conditions with stable semantic keys and typed parameters; retain a translated note escape hatch. For Malamar use device_upside_down on a level-up rule, not inkay_method or a generic rotate_device action.

findings.title: Overworld weather precision missing
findings.detail: Rain means overworld rain, not a move/ability-created battle weather effect. Normal Goodra also has an overworld-fog alternative in Generation VII. Scope this separately from the Hisuian-form rule.

findings.title: Runerigus and ZA Overqwil details need authoritative resolution
findings.detail: Bulbapedia describes cumulative attack damage without fainting (healing allowed) for Runerigus, whereas Serebii ZA says presently missing more than 49 HP. For Overqwil ZA, Bulbapedia counts hits including multiple targets; Serebii/PokeAPI summarize move uses. Keep these precise details marked disputed rather than converting prose directly into executable conditions.

findings.title: Evolution resource catalog lacks required items
findings.detail: data/items.json lacks Black Augurite, Peat Block, the two Scrolls, Linking Cord, Leaders Crest and Gimmighoul Coin. Support non-held evolution items and bag materials; add reference validation for evoFromItem/evoFromMove (currently the integrity test validates the ability and predecessor references but not these).
